data.current_description: Streamable HTTP MCP, three rails: portal (services, prices, call slots, booking, contact, guides), analyzer (identity check, AI visibility audit) and atlas (tool matching, a tool's measured record, search, market changes, coupons). Open without a token: a guest gets every open tool under per-address allowances and the audit as a survey. A token adds the member tools and the account's own tier; a member tool called without one answers 401 with WWW-Authenticate. Stateless, no session. `/api/mcp/{rail}` serves one rail.
data.description_suggestion: JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint providing access to three tool rails: portal (services, pricing, booking), analyzer (AI visibility audits), and atlas (tool discovery and market data). Accepts optional OAuth token (audience `https://inite.ai/api/mcp`). Without authentication, guests access public tools and audit surveys. With token, authenticated users access member-only tools and account-specific tier information. Unauthenticated calls to member tools return 401 with WWW-Authenticate header. Supports streaming responses. Stateless operation with no session management. Individual rails available at `/api/mcp/{rail}`.
